Founded in 1988, Kingsoft Office Software Inc. is a global leader in software with over 3,000 employees. Featured in the Forbes Global 2000 list, our flagship product, WPS Office, offers Writer, Spreadsheet, Presentation, and PDF tools to streamline office tasks. With more than 600 million monthly active users, we are dedicated to providing a better "Workplace Platform Service". Our mission and values Mission Create with simplicity, express with ease, and promote the connection of values. Values Customer First /Perseverance in Innovation / Integrity and Honesty / Optimism and Resilience Vision We strive to be a company that users value, employees are proud of and the society respects. By providing office services that surpass expectations and amaze, we aim to lead the global office services industry. Kingsoft Office's Social Responsibility Supporting Education and Non-Profits Kingsoft Inc. has donated 40 WPS Office licenses to enhance digital teaching and learning at the Ahmadu Bello University Zaria. Contributing to Desertification Control WPS Office has donated 10,000 Saxaul trees to the SEE Foundation, supporting desertification control initiatives in the Alashan region. Spearheading the Paperless Office Revolution WPS Office facilitates paperless office practices by offering features like document management, digital signatures, online collaboration, and electronic spreadsheets. Promoting Environmental Knowledge WPS Office has created an extensive collection of eco-friendly Word posters and presentation templates, with over 2 million views and over 900,000 downloads.
